snippet.title: Tetra eSports - Stacky Awards 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Did you miss it? At The Stacky Awards 2025, Tetra Developer Studios presented a new trailer for its upcoming game, Tetra eSports, releasing as an alpha in August 2025.

If you wish keep track of the game's development, follow us on social media!

X (formerly known as Twitter): https://x.com/TetraDevStudio
Bsky: https://bsky.app/profile/tetradev.studio
Discord: https://discord.gg/6EFdcGuWKn
